prompt: Compare KO filing year 2025 and AMZN filing year 2024, both with the exact SectionItem filter "Item 7": retrieve each company's foreign currency impact disclosures. Retrieve evidence separately for each company and do not relax the section filter.

hops.rationale: The KO 2025 filing's Item 7 passages together state the core foreign currency impact facts. Passage 66 gives the total FX impact including hedging: a 5% decrease in net operating revenues and an 11% decrease in operating income for 2024 (4% and 8% for 2023), plus net FX exchange losses of $180M (2024) and $312M (2023). Passage 39 says FX unfavorably affected consolidated operating income by 11%, names the currencies involved, and describes the offsetting weaker-dollar effect. Passage 40 gives segment-level FX impacts (EMEA 15%, Latin America 17%). Passage 34 says FX is expected to have an unfavorable impact on full-year 2025 net operating revenues. The AMZN portion of the audit prompt is a separate subquery and was not scored here.
